summary: Yield the replication admission writer between short atomic chunks and verify envelope signatures before queueing receipt

replay.detail: No new startup or heal replay. Existing pending envelopes use the same admission checks, per-envelope savepoints and durable admitted frontier, in smaller transactions.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema version or persisted format changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, tombstone exclusions, membership authority and admission semantics remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Wire and client shapes are unchanged. Whole-page receipt remains atomic and retry-idempotent. Aligned modern projection digests can be compared without a legacy graph digest; legacy comparison still requires its digest. This does not change the outbound legacy-peer negotiation.

downtime.detail: Only the normal binary restart is needed. No additional migration or recovery phase is introduced; production latency and restart timing have not yet been measured for this change.

manual.detail: Existing stores need no manual repair or coordinated fleet upgrade.

recovery.detail: There is no migration to undo. Older binaries can read the unchanged store; an interrupted admission resumes from existing pending envelopes and committed frontiers.
